applicability: Deduplication of family expression excerpts from carried before/after realization claims.
conditions: Claims are grouped by repository path and recorded source identity.
Observed identities and resolution outcomes remain separate per-side readings.
exclusions: The same path with different recorded identities must remain distinct.
A realization mismatch is not an authored semantic verdict or the comparison source-inventory count.
statement: Expression grouping keeps recorded source identity in the deduplication key and observed identities as per-side readings.
